description: Implement 'New' badge for confirmed appointments and video call invite flow
steps: Update frontend/src/screens/student/my-appointments.tsx to show 'New' badge for confirmed appointments created within last 24 hours
Add socket listener in frontend/src/screens/shared/VideoCallScreen.tsx for 'call-invite' event to show modal when counselor starts video session
Add 'New' visual indicator in frontend/src/screens/counselor/AppointmentsScreen.jsx for appointments newly approved (status changed from 'Pending' to 'Confirmed' in last 24h)
Add socket event 'student-joined-call' emitter in VideoCallScreen.tsx when student joins room, and receiver in counselor VideoSessionScreen.jsx to show 'Student joined' message
acceptance_criteria: Confirmed appointments created within 24 hours show a 'New' badge in student's My Appointments
Student receives real-time invite when counselor starts video session
Student can accept invite and join the same Jitsi room as counselor
Counselor sees confirmation when student joins the video call
verification: Login as student, create new confirmed appointment, verify 'New' badge appears for 24 hours
Login as counselor, start video session from an appointment, verify student receives invite
Student accepts invite, both join same room, counselor sees student joined notification
